rationale: Record teaching the browser capture tree that a recovered rotation can carry its subtree into the IR instead of forcing every rotated node with children onto the painted-element fallback path, which is what blocked knob pointers whose rotation owns a pseudo-element dot child. The recovery walk refuses text runs, subtree-owning tags, nested rotations, unsolvable boxes, and descendants that paint before their ancestor, and stays off under flatten_to_paint_order. Watch-only: no design-import or rendering authority is transferred, and the painted fallback path is unchanged for everything the walk refuses.
tests: a pure rotation recovers its own box and angle
a rotated knob pointer carries its indicator dot
a rotated element whose subtree cannot come along stays a hole
the flattened emission keeps a rotated subtree captured
